'''Masaaki Iwane''' ({{j|岩根雅明}} ''Iwane Masaaki''; born August 13, 1965) is one of the founding animation directors and key animators of [[Pokémon animation]]. For almost the entirety of his career, he has been a traditional animator, with his first ever fully digitally animated episode in both the layout and key animation stages being [[HZ041]].[https://archive.is/gCynS Iwane talking about an upcoming episode (HZ041) and his effort to solo-animate and create layouts for entirely in digital, for the first time.] ==Animation credits== Credits are listed in order of most senior role, then in order of their release.
